Legacy YAML can be converted without execution to strict deterministic CreateDownloadRequest JSON. Download execution remains a typed idempotent durable job. Unsafe or unrepresentable identity, destination, dynamic-time and runtime settings fail closed.
Both inspect an immutable registered dataset version; the v1 response uses typed application contracts.
Deep validation remains explicit; JSON envelopes and exit codes differ.

The legacy command performs offline fail-closed verification of an external Parquet corpus and emits content-addressed lineage evidence. A typed v1 application command and Dataset Registry import remain pending; no automatic mutation alias is authorized.

The legacy command performs fail-closed durable registration of an accepted external corpus into LocalStorage and SQLiteDatasetRegistry with immutable dataset identity and sanitized evidence. A typed v1 application import command remains pending; no automatic mutation alias is authorized.
Both expose local storage, registry and adapter diagnostics.
Registry health is incorporated into the broader typed doctor response.

Direct mutable invocation is replaced by a typed actor-scoped idempotent durable job that pins the immutable parent version and hash, recovers by job identity and publishes one new Registry version. Cancellation remains unavailable until a canonical UPDATE cancellation identity is proven.

Direct backfill is replaced by one actor-scoped idempotent durable job that pins the immutable parent version, hash and stream timeframe, rejects overlap with registered stream partitions, directs replacement to repair and reconciles publication by durable job identity. Cancellation remains unavailable until a canonical BACKFILL cancellation identity is proven.
Direct repair is intentionally replaced by preview, actor-bound one-time confirmation and action-specific durable execution.
Caller-provided --target is prohibited. V1 publishes deterministic immutable artifacts only below the application-owned artifact root.
Manual run-ID resume is replaced by startup recovery, leases, fencing and reconciliation of the same durable job.
Cancellation moves from backend run IDs to public durable job IDs and remains limited to explicitly cancellable phases.
